analyst_view.overall: Freiburg (14th, 6 pts) host Twente (3rd, 9 pts) in a game that matters for both: Freiburg are close to the top eight and Twente want to stay in it. Freiburg are in fine form, third in the Bundesliga after a 1-0 win at Elversberg on Saturday and unbeaten in 13 straight European home games, while Twente have won all three league-phase games and beat Willem II 2-1 at the weekend after a 9-0 win at Excelsior earlier in the month. Neither club has reported new injuries ahead of this game, and both missing lists are empty. The numbers already count Twente's hot attacking run and Freiburg's stingy recent defending in their momentum adjustments. No referee is named yet, and no full team-news preview is out this early.
